name: Mercure Koh Chang Hideaway
short_description: A 96-room, 4-star resort on the rocky southern edge of Bailan Beach, with two pools and no direct sandy-beach swimming.
ai_summary: Mercure Koh Chang Hideaway is a four-star resort on the quiet, rocky southern edge of Bailan Bay on Koh Chang's west coast, around 3 km from Bang Bao fishing village. The 96 rooms and villas include a Pool Villa category with a private plunge pool, alongside two outdoor pools -- one an adults-oriented sea-view pool praised for its sunset views -- plus Hideaway Spa, two fitness centers and a hot tub. Reviews describe modern, spacious rooms and good value for a 4-star property, but consistently note the rocky waterfront limits sea swimming at the resort itself, the location is far from Koh Chang's nightlife, and extras like breakfast, wifi and minibar can carry additional charges.

faqs.question: Can you swim at the beach at Mercure Koh Chang Hideaway?
faqs.answer: Not easily -- the resort sits on a rocky stretch of southern Bailan Beach, so most guests travel a short distance to nearby sandy beaches like Bang Bao for swimming rather than swimming directly at the property.

faqs.question: Does Mercure Koh Chang Hideaway have villas with private pools?
faqs.answer: Yes -- alongside standard, superior and deluxe rooms, the resort offers a Pool Villa category (about 123 sqm) with a private plunge pool, positioned as the top accommodation tier for guests who want their own pool rather than the shared main pool.
